summary: The PR addresses an issue with resolving the output field for the MOD operator in numeric expressions but lacks additional context and tests.

issues.description: There are no new tests added to verify the functionality of the MOD operator with different numeric types, which is crucial for ensuring the fix works as intended.
The PR does not provide comprehensive coverage of all edge cases involving the MOD operator with different numeric types, such as negative numbers or zero division scenarios.
The PR does not include any documentation or comments explaining the changes made or the rationale behind them, which is important for future maintenance.
